inventory.method: Install all 16 plugins into an isolated CODEX_HOME, run `codex debug prompt-input`, and byte-count skill entry lines and the enclosing Skills section.

activation.reason: Stage 0 proves prompt presence only. Model-backed activation and outcome scoring is deliberately not claimed before the Stage 4 bounded evaluation harness exists.

known_failures.summary: Ten source skills have no plugin package or marketplace publication path.
known_failures.disposition: Package, replace, or explicitly retire every source-only skill.

known_failures.summary: All 73 packaged skills are implicitly eligible without evidence that the set meets an ambiguity or metadata budget.
known_failures.disposition: Curate implicit entrypoints using the versioned evaluation cases.

known_failures.summary: Packaged guidance still presents historical slash-style skill commands that Codex does not expose as first-class custom commands.
Packaged Markdown contains host-specific commands and `.claude/` runtime paths whose safety currently depends on prose adaptations.
known_failures.disposition: Validate each reference semantically and repair or time-bound every unexplained occurrence.

known_failures.summary: Direct recall, indirect recall, negative precision, procedure adherence, and output fidelity have no reproducible measured baseline.
known_failures.disposition: Run the cases through the bounded live evaluation lane and publish aggregate results.
